protocol.temporal_concat: [z_(t-5)..z_t] -> 6 latents (spec said 5*192; note mandates 6 positions ending at t -> 6*d)
protocol.velocity: pseudo-velocity: first difference of state within episode (npz has no qvel field)

probes.mlp: Linear(d,256)-GELU-Dropout(0.1)-Linear(256,out), AdamW lr1e-3 wd1e-4, batch64, <=300 ep, early stop patience 20 on window-level val slice of train episodes, restore best; 3 seeds

protocol.split: episode-level 75/25 (rng(123)), held-out R2 uniform average over NON-CONSTANT columns of the 128-d target; literal 128-col average kept as r2_full128 (JSON only) -- constant padded columns would score 1.0 for ridge vs 0.0 for MLP (force_finite artifact)
